errors.name: CustomerNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a customer is requested but not found in the database by customer_id.

errors.name: ProductNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a product is requested but not found in the database by product_id.

errors.name: CategoryNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a category is requested but not found in the database by category_id.

errors.name: OrderNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an order is requested but not found in the database by order_id.

errors.name: OrderItemNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an order item is requested but not found in the database by order_item_id.

errors.name: InvoiceNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an invoice is requested but not found in the database by invoice_id.

errors.name: InvalidOrderStatusError
errors.description: Raised when an order status is set to a value not in the allowed set: 'pending', 'confirmed', 'shipped', 'cancelled'.

errors.name: InsufficientStockError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to confirm an order that contains products with insufficient stock.

errors.name: InvalidProductIdError
errors.description: Raised when a product ID is provided that does not exist or is invalid.

errors.name: InvalidCategoryIdError
errors.description: Raised when a category ID is provided that does not exist or is invalid.

errors.name: InvalidCustomerIdError
errors.description: Raised when a customer ID is provided that does not exist or is invalid.

errors.name: OrderAlreadyConfirmedError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to confirm an order that is already confirmed or shipped.

errors.name: OrderCannotBeCancelledError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to cancel an order that is not confirmed.

errors.name: OrderCannotBeShippedError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to ship an order that is not confirmed.

errors.name: OrderCannotBeCancelledAfterShipmentError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to cancel an order that has already been shipped.

errors.name: FileNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when the SQLite database file is not found at the specified path.

errors.name: MalformedCSVError
errors.description: Raised when a CSV file contains malformed data that cannot be parsed into valid records.
